open_findings.summary: Canonical HNSW Delete() is soft-only (hnsw.go:629); no online compaction is reachable in canonical mode (main.go:3458 close(compactDone)); and restart does NOT reclaim because Export serializes tombstones (hnsw.go:748-763) and Import re-adds them unconditionally (hnsw.go:880). RSS and the on-disk snapshot grow ~linearly with cumulative deletes (~1.9 KB/delete, +14 MB/min under churn) with no online or restart remedy; only drop+recreate of the collection reclaims.
open_findings.disposition: OWNER ship/no-ship: (1) ship RC with a hard documented limitation (no delete reclamation; drop+recreate to reclaim), or (2) unfreeze d5b2d3a to add reclamation (small Import-skip-deleted fix restores restart-reclaim, or full online canonical compaction). Either code change forces a new candidate SHA and a full evidence-matrix re-run.
open_findings.reviewer_recommendation: option (2) Import-skip is small and low-risk and restores a genuine reclamation path; timing vs freeze is the owner's call
